title: SafetyDegradationTracker: A Tool for Measuring Safety Alignment Erosion During Fine-Tuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: real-time monitoring of safety erosion during fine-tuning catches degradation early, preventing deployment of unsafe models. Directly addresses a documented failure mode (46-66% attack success rate increase).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a HuggingFace Trainer callback requires understanding the Trainer API and evaluation hooks. Using SORRY-Bench as probes is straightforward, but integrating the callback into a training loop adds moderate complexity for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: A Trainer callback with checkpoint evaluation is a focused deliverable, but requires setting up fine-tuning, running it, and producing erosion curves. The callback itself is narrow, but demonstrating it requires a full fine-tuning run.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
